description: mod-reporting deployment configuration template. Default values are calibrated against the reference bugfest environment (3 standalone tenants, 11 consortia tenants) as recorded in 'Trillium (R1 2026) - Modules configuration details' (module: 2 instances, 64 CPU units, memory 1024, memoryReservation 896; sidecar: the default sidecar values). See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management). mod-reporting is written in Go, not Java, so it has no JVM settings: the maxMetaspaceSize/Xmx values listed for it in the bugfest table (128m/768m) have no effect and are deliberately omitted. Null values must be supplied at deploy time or indicate that no override is recommended; see each description.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-reporting container, matching the bugfest baseline for modules not listed individually

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-reporting container in MiB, matching the bugfest baseline. The module is a small Go binary; most memory use comes from buffering large query results

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-reporting container in MiB, matching the bugfest baseline

deployment.description: mod-reporting keeps no persistent state of its own: reporting-database settings live in mod-settings, and the only in-process state is a per-token cache of sessions and database connections that each replica builds independently. It therefore supports multiple replicas for HA. Two replicas match the bugfest baseline.

kong.description: The read timeout is raised above the 60s default because report and query requests (/ldp/db/query, /ldp/db/reports) may legitimately run for as long as MOD_REPORTING_QUERY_TIMEOUT (300 seconds by default) before Postgres cancels them. Keep the read timeout a little above that value if it is changed.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: TCP port on which the HTTP server listens, overriding the port in the bundled configuration file (which is 12369).

EnvVars.name: LOGCAT
EnvVars.description: Comma-separated list of logging categories to emit (see README); the 'curl' category exposes live access tokens and must never be enabled in production.

EnvVars.name: LOGGING_CATEGORIES
EnvVars.description: Alternative to LOGCAT that takes precedence over it when set; leave unset and use LOGCAT.

EnvVars.name: MOD_REPORTING_QUERY_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Maximum time in seconds that Postgres may spend running any reporting query before it is cancelled, overriding the configuration file's queryTimeout (120); keep the Kong read timeout above this value.

EnvVars.name: MOD_REPORTING_SESSION_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Lifetime in seconds of each cached session (and its reporting-database connection), keyed by FOLIO URL, tenant and access token; the default is slightly longer than the ten-minute FOLIO access-token lifespan. Lower it to pick up changes to the reporting-database configuration sooner.

EnvVars.name: REPORTING_DB_URL
EnvVars.description: Full PostgreSQL URL of the reporting database (MetaDB or LDP Classic); overrides the per-tenant setting stored in mod-settings only when REPORTING_DB_USER and REPORTING_DB_PASS are also set. Normally left unset.

EnvVars.name: REPORTING_DB_USER
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL user for the reporting-database override; used only together with REPORTING_DB_URL and REPORTING_DB_PASS.

EnvVars.name: REPORTING_DB_PASS
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password for the reporting-database override, supplied through secret management; used only together with REPORTING_DB_URL and REPORTING_DB_USER.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Development only: FOLIO gateway URL used for requests that arrive without an X-Okapi-Url header, e.g. when the module is run standalone. Leave unset in production.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_TENANT
EnvVars.description: Development only: tenant to log in to at OKAPI_URL. Leave unset in production.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_USER
EnvVars.description: Development only: username for logging in at OKAPI_URL. Leave unset in production.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_PW
EnvVars.description: Development only: password for logging in at OKAPI_URL. Leave unset in production.

EnvVars.name: FOLIOGO_SESSION_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Development only: forces the refresh interval in seconds of the OKAPI_URL login session instead of deriving it from the token expiry. Leave unset.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of the co-located mod-reporting container. Must be set: the sidecar's own default uses port 8081, whereas mod-reporting listens on 12369 unless SERVER_PORT says otherwise.
